brief:
Ali al-Bazari, a Palestinian farmer, was killed by Israeli settlers during olive harvest operations in the West Bank, the Palestine News Network reported. The incident occurred in the Nablus or Tulkarm area as al-Bazari's family worked to gather their crop.

The death has left al-Bazari's family mourning and searching for answers about the circumstances that led to his killing during what should have been a routine agricultural activity.
dek: NABLUS/TULKARM, West Bank / PNN — For Ali al-Bazari’s family, the olive harvest ended in grief.
title: Israeli settlers kill Palestinian farmer Ali al-Bazari during olive harvest
